data.smt_query:
; Freehold SMT-LIB query
(set-logic ALL)
(declare-const SKU Int)
(declare-const quantity Int)
(declare-const sku String)
(assert (>= (str.indexof sku "SKU" 0) 0))
(assert (>= quantity 0))
(assert (not (= 0 0)))
(check-sat)
; unsat means proved
